title: Input validation: reject empty/blank --id/--title/--content and required-flag checks
acceptance_criteria: Before any HTTP call, validate inputs: (a) --id, --title, --content must be non-empty and non-whitespace-only strings (reject '', ' ', '\t', '\n'); (b) 'create' requires --title AND --content; (c) 'read', 'update', 'delete' require --id; (d) 'update' must include at least one of --title/--content/--tags (otherwise reject). On any validation failure: print 'Error: <clear message>' to stderr (e.g., 'Error: --title is required', 'Error: --id cannot be empty or whitespace'), exit code 1, NO stack traces in output. Tests in tests/cli.test.ts cover: empty string (''), whitespace-only (' ', '\t'), missing required flag for each subcommand, and confirm exit code 1 + stderr contains 'Error:' + no 'Error:' on stdout. 'npm test', 'npm run build', 'npm run lint' all pass.
notes: cost-estimate: bucket=M model=standard doer_tokens=1400 reviewer_tokens=616 output_usd=0.0302

title: CRUD subcommands: list, read, create, update, delete
acceptance_criteria: Five subcommands implemented in src/cli.ts (or src/cli/commands/*): 'list [--tag=<t>] [--q=<q>]' GETs /api/notes with query params; 'read --id=<id>' GETs /api/notes/:id; 'create --title=<t> --content=<c> [--tags=<t1,t2>]' POSTs JSON to /api/notes; 'update --id=<id> [--title=<t>] [--content=<c>] [--tags=<t1,t2>]' PUTs JSON to /api/notes/:id; 'delete --id=<id>' DELETEs /api/notes/:id. Success: prints API JSON via JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) to stdout, exit 0 (delete with 204 prints empty result and exits 0). API error (4xx/5xx): prints 'Error: <message>' to stderr, exit 1. Network error: prints 'Error: Could not connect to API at <url>' to stderr, exit 1. Uses Node built-in fetch. Tests in tests/cli.test.ts mock global.fetch and cover each subcommand happy path + at least one API-error path + one network-error path. 'npm test', 'npm run build', 'npm run lint' all pass.
